_help: This is aidlc-docs/lean.json: people edit it, the agent cannot. Everything AI-DLC Lean keeps in git lives under aidlc-docs/: one folder per intent, the audit ledger (aidlc-docs/audit/) and the contracts (contracts_dir). checks: commands that must all pass, e.g. ["pytest -q", "ruff check ."]; lean verify runs them and writes the intent's construction/build-and-test/build-and-test-summary.md. protected_paths: acceptance tests the agent may not change, e.g. ["tests/acceptance/**"]. plan: whether each unit's code-generation plan needs a PLAN approval before its code: auto (regulated mode only) | always | never. approvers: optional allow-lists by git email per approval kind (IDEATION, REQUIREMENTS, DESIGN, INCEPTION, PLAN, RELEASE, CR), e.g. {"RELEASE": ["lead@corp.com"]}. deny_commands and fingerprint_exclude can be overridden too (see aidlc_lean.py DEFAULT_CONFIG).
